title_zh: 2025 KET 校园版真题 3 · 第 1 套 · 阅读 Part 2（B3T1）
source_label: 个人教研使用 · Cambridge KET 真题 3 Test 1 Part 2
topic_subtitle: Three teenagers talk about learning a new language

people.name: Frank
people.paragraph: At the moment, I'm learning Arabic because I'd like to be a journalist one day, and being able to speak other languages is important for this job. It wasn't possible to learn Arabic at school, but a friend of mine knew a woman who could give me lessons and now she comes to my house twice a week. It was difficult at first because I was a complete beginner. But I worked hard and after just six months I was able to speak and write the language quite well, which I'm really happy about.

people.name: Marc
people.paragraph: I've lived in lots of different countries because of my dad's career, so I've had to learn several different languages. I seem to learn them quite easily. The last place I lived was Thailand. I'm still studying the language so I can continue to chat with my Thai classmates now I'm back in my home country. I've downloaded a new app with exercises in Thai, and I can't wait to use it each morning because it's so much fun.

people.name: Ivan
people.paragraph: My mum comes from Russia and her parents still live there. We often stay with them during the school holidays, but unfortunately I didn't learn Russian when I was little so talking to them has always been hard. After our last trip I decided it was time for me to learn the language and I found a course at my local college – we work hard but the teacher makes us laugh. I think that's why I never forget any of the vocabulary she teaches us.

questions.question: Who says he's pleased about how quickly he improved?
questions.explanation_zh: Frank 提到六个月即可较好读写阿拉伯语，并对此非常高兴。

questions.question: Who is learning a foreign language without a teacher?
questions.explanation_zh: Marc 使用 App 自学泰语，未提及老师授课。

questions.question: Who needs to know a foreign language for the career he wants?
questions.explanation_zh: Frank 想学阿拉伯语是因为希望成为记者。

questions.question: Who says he remembers all the new words he learns in his language lessons?
questions.explanation_zh: Ivan 表示老师有趣，因此从不忘记所学词汇。

questions.question: Who is practising a language so he can have conversations with friends?
questions.explanation_zh: Marc 继续学泰语以便与泰国同学聊天。

questions.question: Who is studying a foreign language for family reasons?
questions.explanation_zh: Ivan 因母亲来自俄罗斯、需与祖辈沟通而学习俄语。

questions.question: Who says he has lots of experience learning new languages?
questions.explanation_zh: Marc 因父亲职业在多国生活，学过多种语言且学得较快。
